verdict.rationale: Publishing portal source under an open license is a fair question for a government filing service, since some public-sector portals are open-sourced, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a source repository, a license, or open-source code for the Secretary of State's portals or the Ohio Business Gateway. The items cover only portal features, sign-in, tax services, and robots.txt access walls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
